message:
The other day, as I was preparing for a possible storm, I found myself rummaging through the attic for supplies. In between the flashlights and batteries, I stumbled upon a dusty old board game from my childhood. It got me thinking—when was the last time my family and I sat down for a game night? 

So, I gathered everyone around, and we played for hours, laughing and reminiscing. Turns out, when the weather outside is frightful, a little low-tech fun can be just delightful! 

What’s your favorite way to keep entertained when the storm rolls in?
